title: Example Gateway Industrial Park closing statement (sale)
summary: Example Gateway Industrial Park · Sale closed June 30, 2026

evidence.quote: The sale of Example Gateway Industrial Park, 4100 Example Gateway Pkwy, Phoenix, AZ, by Example Gateway Industrial Park Owner LLC to Example Logistics REIT closed on June 30, 2026.
Selling costs (the broker's commission to Example Industrial Advisors, title, transfer tax and legal fees) total $5,139,000.
The payoff of the seller's loan is $34,543,544.
Net proceeds to the seller are $45,967,456.
